**RESIGNATION LETTER**

To the Meta Board of Directors,

After much reflection, I am writing to inform you of my decision to resign as Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of Meta Platforms, Inc., effective [date].

When I founded Facebook in my dorm room nearly two decades ago, I could never have imagined the journey we would take together. What began as a simple way to connect college students has evolved into a global platform serving billions of people worldwide. I am incredibly proud of what we have built together—from Facebook and Instagram to WhatsApp and our investments in virtual and augmented reality through Reality Labs.

However, I believe the time has come for new leadership to guide Meta into its next chapter. The challenges facing our company—from regulatory scrutiny to the complex transition toward the metaverse—require fresh perspectives and renewed energy. While I remain deeply committed to our mission of bringing the world closer together, I recognize that my continued presence in this role may not serve the company's best interests moving forward.

I want to express my profound gratitude to our employees, who have worked tirelessly to innovate and push boundaries. To our users, who have trusted us with their connections and communities. And to our shareholders, who have supported our vision even during challenging times.

I will work closely with the Board to ensure a smooth transition and will remain available as an advisor if helpful.

Sincerely,

Mark Zuckerberg
